paper.title_en: The generalized entropy in holographic semiclassical de Sitter spacetime
paper.abstract_en: We consider generalized de Sitter entropy which includes both entanglement entropy of the strongly coupled quantum field and the gravitational Wald entropy in the framework of holographic semiclassical gravity. The quantum corrected de Sitter spacetime is constructed perturbatively by considering static deformations of the classical solution. By applying the Noether charge formula to our semiclassical model, we show that both the renormalized entropies remain finite without introducing a cutoff, even when the bulk AdS gravitational field does not satisfy the Dirichlet boundary condition. We show that the first order variation of the generalized entropy with respect to the de Sitter horizon always vanishes when the conformal boundary metric is promoted to a dynamical variable.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文在全息半经典引力框架下研究广义de Sitter熵，将强耦合量子场的纠缠熵与Wald引力熵结合，并借助Noether荷公式讨论重整化熵的有限性及广义熵一阶变分的消失，与黑洞/宇宙视界热力学及引力基础问题高度相关，理论深度较高，值得点击阅读。
decision.title_zh: 全息半经典de Sitter时空中的广义熵
decision.abstract_zh: 我们在全息半经典引力框架下考虑广义de Sitter熵，它同时包含强耦合量子场的纠缠熵与引力的Wald熵。量子修正的de Sitter时空通过考虑经典解的静态形变以微扰方式构造。通过将Noether荷公式应用于我们的半经典模型，我们表明，即使体AdS引力场不满足Dirichlet边界条件，两种重整化熵也保持有限而无需引入截断。我们表明，当共形边界度规被提升为动力学变量时，广义熵相对于de Sitter视界的一阶变分总是消失。
